frames.feel: sparse intro, intermittent bass pulses, void drops at 12s
frames.visual: Title types in character-by-character on first bass hit at 1s, each word on separate line. Cursor blinks. Slow blue glow pulses with bass hits. Frame goes black on DROP at 12s.

frames.feel: heavy bass surge at 13s, sustained high energy, rhythmic section
frames.visual: SURGE at 13s: word slams in full-screen, each letter a separate div that scales/rotates on beat hits. Blue accent (#00A8E8) strobes on snare. Letters jitter horizontally on hi-hat hits.

frames.feel: warm mid-range, building tension, hard drop at 49s into void
frames.visual: Four words stack vertically, center-aligned. Each word fades in on phrase boundary (28s, 33s, 39s, 44s). Subtle scale pulse on bass hits. DROP at 49s: all text drops off bottom edge with easing.

frames.feel: major surge at 50s and 55s, dense energy, hi-hat roll at 62-63s
frames.visual: SURGE 50s: 'AI' appears top-left in huge type. SURGE 55s: 'PAIR' slams center. SURGE 61s: 'PROGRAMMING' types in bottom-right. Blue pixel noise flickers on each word during hi-hat roll 62-63s.

frames.feel: warm descent, hard drop at 73s, void at 74-75s, final drop 76s
frames.visual: Two-word lockup center-screen, appears at 66s with soft glow. Words breathe with bass. DROP 73s: glow intensifies then cuts. Void 74-75s: faint outline only. DROP 76s: fade to black.
Black screen. At 77s, small monospace 'ANTHROPICS' fades in bottom-center (#4A5568 muted gray). Holds still until end.
